From Schott Key No.1 · Price: touch only, and only from your left hand to your right.

Theme Space

  • 1: 1 action: anything your left hand touches (Bulk 1 or less, unattended) moves to your right hand.
  • 5: Attended objects (@Check[reflex|against:stand]{Reflex} negates), letting you Disarm with a touch.
  • 9: Surge: move a creature's held weapon into your hand (@Check[reflex|against:stand]{Reflex} negates), or remove a 5-ft section of wall you touch, leaving a hole.
  • 13: Move a Small creature your left hand touches to any space within 10 ft of you (@Check[fortitude|against:stand]{Fortitude} negates).
  • 17: Move a Medium creature.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC.
